form: A complete answer must give one exact value of d: an integer at least 2 or +∞. A finite value must be justified by existence of a uniform, non-homogeneous bundle of rank less than 2d on P^d and nonexistence of such bundles on every P^n with 2 ≤ n < d; +∞ requires nonexistence for every n ≥ 2.
not_enough: Bounds or a range for d, examples without ruling out all smaller dimensions, nonexistence results covering only some necessary dimensions or ranks, an assertion that d is unknown or undetermined, or a value conditional on a conjecture would not settle the question.
